installConfigs.instructions: Replace <your-sentry-access-token> with a Sentry User Auth Token. Create one at https://sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens/ with scopes: org:read, project:read, project:write, team:read, event:read, event:write. Provides error monitoring, issue tracking, and AI-powered debugging.

Replace <your-sentry-access-token> with a Sentry User Auth Token. Create one at https://sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens/ with scopes: org:read, project:read, project:write, team:read, event:read, event:write. Provides error monitoring, issue tracking, and AI-powered debugging.
